The '''''Sword & Shield'' arc''' (Japanese: '''第十五章　ソード・シールド編''' ''The Fifteenth Chapter: Sword & Shield arc'') is the fifteenth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}. It began serialization in November 2019, and ended in June 2023. 

The arc follows the adventures of [[Henry Sword]], an expert toolsmith specialized in fixing and maintaining the gear that various Pokémon use, and [[Casey Shield]], a hyperactive girl who helps [[Professor Magnolia]] in her [[Dynamax]] research, as they take part in [[Galar]]'s famed [[Galar League|Gym Challenge]]. Their intention is to use the media attention attracted to them by the event to help Casey find the Pokémon that she had lost a year earlier. They are accompanied on their journey by a boy named [[Marvin]], who recently moved to the region and is still new to everything it has to offer. In the background, [[Rose|Chairman Rose]] of [[Macro Cosmos]] has a plan that could threaten to disrupt the Gym Challenge and the lives of everyone in Galar.

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series games]], [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]].

==Volumes==
===Mini-volumes===
====Japan====
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures Sword & Shield volumes}}
As with the three arcs before it, the ''Sword & Shield'' arc was collected separately into mini-volumes. The [[Pocket Monsters Special Sword Shield volume 1|first volume]] was released on June 26, 2020, with the final volume being released July 28, 2023.

====United States====
{{main|List of Pokémon Sword & Shield volumes}}
An English translation of the ''Sword & Shield'' arc was released by [[VIZ Media]] under the title '''Pokémon Sword & Shield''', which were released in their own mini-volumes as with the three arcs before it. The [[Pokémon Sword & Shield volume 1|first volume]] was released on August 10, 2021.
